evidence: Touches mempool eviction logic during reorgs in src/validation.cpp and carries the Mempool label.
rationale: Fixes a bug where valid BIP68 transactions with unconfirmed parents and all their descendants are incorrectly evicted from the mempool during a reorg due to stale cached lockpoints. Correct mempool retention and eviction behavior directly impacts transaction propagation and second-layer protocols relying on relative timelocks.
